question:
四张合成表：orders一行一笔订单；items一行一条商品明细，quantity为件数、unit_price为成交单价，金额单位人民币元；refunds一行一笔退款事件，amount为退款金额；targets一行一个自然月×地区的销售目标。关联键分别为order_id和月份×地区。order_date为本地下单日期，无时区换算；refunds没有结算日期，只能归属到原订单期间，不能回答现金退款发生月份。数据覆盖2026年1—4月，含取消单；未提供成本、税费和经营费用。所有订单的商品明细已完整提供。订单取消状态为canceled，已完成为completed。

业务背景：本任务已确认：只统计completed订单，销售额为quantity×unit_price合计，不含运费；退款单列，仅扣settled退款，归属于原订单日期，不是退款现金发生期。订单按order_id计数，客单价为商品销售额/已完成订单数。自然月含月首至次月月首之前；未知保持未知，不擅自填零或改原表。原始商品明细完整，订单无退款记录表示该范围内无已结退款。

当前问题：给我2026年2月商品销售、已结退款和退款后金额，顺便判断净利润能否算；资料不足的部分列清楚，其他部分继续。

requirements: 2026年2月商品销售额（quantity×unit_price合计，不含运费，仅completed订单）
2026年2月归属原订单期间的已结退款额（仅settled）
2026年2月退款后金额（商品销售额减已结退款额）
判断净利润能否计算并列出资料不足部分

correct_sql:
WITH feb_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS sales_amount
  FROM items i
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-02-01'
    AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-03-01'
),
feb_refunds AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.status = 'settled'
    AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-02-01'
    AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT
  s.sales_amount AS "商品销售额",
  r.refund_amount AS "已结退款额",
  s.sales_amount - r.refund_amount AS "退款后金额"
FROM feb_sales s
CROSS JOIN feb_refunds r;
wrong_sql:
WITH feb_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(i.quantity * 1.0) AS item_amount
    FROM items i
    JOIN orders o
      ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-02-01'
      AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-03-01'
),
feb_refunds AS (
    SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS settled_refund_amount
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o
      ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.status = 'settled'
      AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-02-01'
      AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT
    s.item_amount AS "商品销售额",
    f.settled_refund_amount AS "已结退款额",
    s.item_amount - f.settled_refund_amount AS "退款后金额"
FROM feb_sales s
CROSS JOIN feb_refunds f;
